display_transform.purpose: visualization only; raw product values are retained above
display_transform.stretch_method: 2nd to 98th percentile of display-eligible AOI samples

grid.coordinate_convention: pixel centers per GCOV product specification

interpretation_limits: One source observation only; no temporal change is measured.
Provider QA is displayed unchanged and does not authorize analysis.
Mask and exception flags use product-documented definitions; the display screen does not override provider QA.
No event, cause, damage, or ground condition is inferred from this layer.

input_data_exception_mask_attributes.description: Bitwise OR of input data exception codes for each image pixel (0: no anomaly, 2: NISAR LSAR qFSP-H1 sample slip)
